notes: The mound of the Nirnaeth dead, alone green in Anfauglith; Rían died upon it.
within the Dominion of Angband boundary as the living map draws it, F.A. 1–545 [I-M]

timeline.cite: HoME XI, the Tale of Years [C]; VECTOR_MAP_SPEC §4, 'HERE LAY BELERIAND, DROWNED' [I-H]; the exception is stated in The Silmarillion's own index: 'Beleriand was broken in the turmoils at the end of the First Age, and invaded by the sea, so that only Ossiriand (Lindon) remained' [C]
timeline.what: Beleriand was drowned; this place stood in that land
